marker-pdf::0.text:
## Boro Rice Varieties in Haor Regions

## Abstract

We compare four BRRI varieties grown in Sunamganj haor during 2025-26. Short-duration varieties escape early flash floods while long-duration ones yield more.

## Results

| Variety     | Yield (t/ha) | Days |
|-------------|--------------|------|
| BRRI dhan28 | 6.0          | 140  |
| BRRI dhan29 | 7.5          | 160  |
| BRRI dhan89 | 8.0          | 155  |
| BRRI dhan92 | 8.2          | 158  |

## Conclusion

BRRI dhan89 balances yield and flood risk best for haor farmers.
